contract.intent: Amend tree-format-spec v4 (locked @ fbaba13) to v5 — the gate events in the event schema: submitted / confirmed / rejected (with gate grill|confirm + feedback), and the completion rule: completed may be written only after confirmed(gate=confirm) (validator-enforced, F-AC15). Produces a COMPLETE superseding artifact.
acceptanceCriteria: tree-format-spec-v5.md artifact exists — complete doc = v4 content + gate events + completion rule
Event types add: submitted / confirmed / rejected — each with gate (grill|confirm); rejected carries feedback
Completion rule: completed may be written only after confirmed(gate=confirm); a node with submitted but no decision = blocked (waiting on human)
Gate flow: submitted(gate=grill) → confirmed/rejected(gate=grill) before execution; submitted(gate=confirm) → confirmed/rejected(gate=confirm) before completed
F-AC15: gate invariants enforced by the validator (the deterministic check that flagged 17 gaps)
v5 locked (type=spec); v4 gets a superseded event; AGENTS.md + resolver point at v5
requiredInputs: Gate confirmation action (17 confirmed events appended, 2026-08-17)
